name: scarpenter-controller
description: The rights of the SCarpenter controller's service account on one OVHcloud Public Cloud project: the OpenStack roles of the driver (Nova, Neutron, Glance, Cinder). For the service-account credentials mode, which is not built yet; an OpenStack user needs the same five roles in the project (docs/how-to-guides/ovh-credentials.md). Replace SERVICE_ACCOUNT_URN and PROJECT_ID. The least-privilege set is not verified (plan 18, spike S6).
